validationHistory.reason: Mac lifecycle automated entire-AX-tree enumeration timed out on the longer cumulative history. Native screenshot showed the dialog and accessible footer; test-only correction uses Escape and durable receipt verification. Source96 UI and all16 hosted browser scenarios passed; other native jobs were superseded.

Earlier exact-source candidate passed every required native job and Hyprland. Superseded before publication when the owner requested wider Settings and cumulative release logs; final package evidence is from the current source only.

Linux packaged startup exposed a premature transcript assertion after Send: window presence already existed. Added a distinct actual-turn completion barrier; canceled superseded candidate builds and reran the full matrix.

Intel editor New Chat assertion expected zero sessions under the superseded selected-chat contract. Owner clarified that an open editor window must remain visible; fresh window-session acceptance is required.
Windows SDK disposable-directory cleanup failed; Intel first webview observation timed out.
Mac editor New Chat retained a stale Orbit selection; Mac lifecycle editor launch used a fixed keyboard delay and did not complete. Linux and Windows required jobs passed.
Intel official Codex webview could not start; Apple Silicon and Linux package lanes passed. No pass is claimed for the Intel lane.

corrections: Wider responsive Settings and cumulative skipped-release logs with a durable upgrade baseline.
Bounded Windows fixture cleanup retains strict removal assertions.

Orbit represents each open VS Code window as one stable session, including empty New Chat; retained backend history adds no entries. Native focus targets the owning extension host without opening or reloading a workspace.
Mac lifecycle test waits for the enabled Choose this folder action instead of assuming keyboard focus after a fixed delay.

limitations: macOS27 environment unavailable; macOS26 results do not establish macOS27 behavior.
Orbit is not supported on Windows; Windows launcher/editor/updater regressions are tested.
Mac bundles are ad-hoc signed; Developer ID and notarization are not configured.
GNOME/KDE hosted compositor checks use nested Wayland; X11, mixed-monitor, scaling, accessibility and long-duration combinations remain outside this completed matrix.
Native SDK updater fixtures do not prove the installed launcher Update button; that UI result is recorded separately.
Existing Desktop and VS Code instances are never force-closed; the current observer/bridge takes effect on their next normal managed launch.
Synthetic account fixtures do not establish new real OAuth authentication coverage.
Final candidate native Hyprland and installed Update-button retests omitted at owner request to publish immediately; no pass claimed.
